annotations.title: Create a tri-fold brochure from a prompt

description: Generate a folded tri-fold brochure (six panels: front cover, inside-flap teaser, the three-panel inside spread, and back) from a text prompt: one model call plans the whole reading journey and — unless generateImage:false — the cover and inside-lead images, then buildBrochure composes each tall panel at the chosen sheet and Style and derives the physical imposition. The brochure analogue of create_flyer, the SAME pipeline the web's brochure screen uses. Returns the new artifact id: read it with read_artifact, download the imposed print PDF with export_artifact. Any free-tier degradation (the AI-image budget ran out, so a panel kept a styled placeholder) comes back as a warning.

direction.description: Free-form creative direction for the outline

generateImage.description: Generate the cover + lead images (default true). false keeps styled placeholders.

prompt.description: What the brochure is for — the organization/offer, audience, and the story to tell

seed.description: Reproducible draw; the same seed + Style gives the same brochure.

sheet.description: The landscape sheet the tri-fold folds: Letter | A4 | Legal. Default Letter.

styleId.description: A curated Style id from list_styles (e.g. botanical). Default the first curated Style.

name: create_brochure
title: Create a tri-fold brochure from a prompt
